name: What is the difference between a functional layout improvement and a cosmetic remodel?
description: Functional layout improvements alter structural flow and space use, while cosmetic remodels focus on surface-level aesthetic updates without changing the layout

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a functional layout improvement and a cosmetic remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A functional layout improvement involves changing the fundamental structure and flow of your home, such as moving walls, reconfiguring room sizes, or altering the placement of utilities. This aims to enhance how the space is used. In contrast, a cosmetic remodel focuses on surface-level updates like painting, new flooring, or updated fixtures without altering the underlying layout. While cosmetic changes refresh aesthetics, functional improvements address deeper inefficiencies. It's important to decide whether you simply want to refresh the look or fundamentally improve how your home works before starting a project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Functional layout improvements alter structural flow and space use, while cosmetic remodels focus on surface-level aesthetic updates without changing the layout. One improves function, the other appearance.
